note: Route-graph ratchet baseline (no-new-rot ratchet). Each entry is the CURRENT reachable-first-party-module-count ceiling for a LOCKED FIXED_ROUTES route (the primary dev-perf 'first-party graph pressure' metric from scripts/route-graph.mjs). The gate fails when a tracked route's count grows BEYOND its ceiling and when the committed baseline raises any ceiling vs the base branch WITHOUT a matching absorb record. Counts are captured WITH the companion extension repos cloned pinned (exactly as CI does via clone-extensions) so they reproduce in CI. Regenerate with `node scripts/audit/route-graph-ratchet.mjs --write-baseline` after cloning the extensions — a ceiling should only ever be LOWERED as barrel imports are narrowed, and is never raised SILENTLY. A sanctioned raise must be ANNOTATED: a sibling `absorbs` record `route -> { from, to, reason, pr }` whose from/to exactly match the raise vs the base branch (from = the base ceiling, to = the new committed ceiling, reason = why the growth is accepted, pr = the PR carrying the absorbed change). The gate validates records strictly (malformed/stale/orphan records fail closed; a carried-forward record may not be deleted while its raised ceiling is kept) and prints a LOUD NOTICE line for every absorbed raise. The tracked route set is route-graph.mjs FIXED_ROUTES; change it there, then regenerate.

/sign-in.reason: cinatra#1367 (PR #1473) chat-capture autosave. The store graph reaches this route via auth -> DB; it gains EXACTLY 5 net-new first-party LEAF modules and, by the sever, does NOT reach the background-jobs registry / detection pipeline: (1) src/lib/chat-capture/enqueue.ts — the persistence-chokepoint hook dynamically imported by upsertChatThreadInDatabase (contract-pinned by chat-capture-enqueue-hook.test.ts); (2) src/lib/chat-capture/enqueue-queue.ts — the registry-FREE BullMQ producer the hook routes through INSTEAD of @/lib/background-jobs (routing through the runtime would drag the background-jobs-registry mega-hub — every job handler: @cinatra-ai/agents/skills/llm/workflows — into the store graph, which is exactly what exploded this route to 1431 and OOM'd the Turbopack build); (3) src/lib/background-jobs-names.ts — the job-name constants leaf the producer imports; (4) src/lib/skill-autosave.ts — the master-switch config read the hook gates on; (5) src/lib/chat-capture-schema.ts — the bootstrap DDL leaf statically imported by drizzle-store.ts (the #1425/#1426/#1427 extract-leaf -> route-graph-absorb pattern, reached by every store route). /sign-in reaches the store but NOT the background-jobs registry, so it gains only these 5 leaves and NEITHER the detection pipeline nor its LLM/skills graph. Measured by the CI ratchet with the companion extension repos cloned pinned (missingCount 0). Absorbed raise 142->147.
